notes: Resume notes hold much more writing now. A card's resume note used to stop at 4,000 characters - and, exactly like the write-up limit before it, it never said so: you could keep typing, Stasys would quietly save only the first part, and the rest was gone the next time the board reloaded. This was found the way these things always are, by losing a real note - a card was sitting at precisely 4,000 characters with its last sentence chopped off mid-word. The limit was never really a decision about your data. It came from the idea that a resume note should be short, which is fair advice but a poor reason to throw away what you wrote. It is now 100,000 characters, the same as a card's write-up - roughly 16,000 words, far more than anyone writes on one card. There is still a limit, so a giant accidental paste cannot bloat your project file, but you should never meet it. Nothing needs doing to your existing cards, and the board itself is unchanged. One thing worth knowing: text already lost to the old limit cannot be recovered, because it never reached the disk. Stasys also still trims without warning you if you ever do reach a limit - that is a separate job already on the board.
